node.chars: Data: synthetic only (spec L68: a seeded synthetic BTCUSDT profile declared on each board): BTCUSDT 30-minute bars seeded 416, 10 Oct – 31 Oct 2026 14:30 UTC; tick size 0.10 from the recorded instrument fixture. No account, key, balance, order or environment on any frame (R-1, C-2.11: no DEMO / LIVE badge, no environment control, no account context)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Fidelity: greyscale wireframe, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0 L68); wire tokens only (§2 L126): color.surface.canvas, color.surface.raised, color.surface.overlay, color.border.default, color.text.primary, color.text.secondary, color.text.tertiary; type.ui.caption, type.ui.label, type.num.sm. Theme dark (0 light twins, §0); hi-fi is E19-D03's

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: R-1 (C-2.11, L97): the panel is environment-neutral; no DEMO / LIVE badge, no environment control and no account context on any frame

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Not drawn — the text is binding (§0 L83): SCR-038/load-failed, SCR-038/stale, SCR-039/comfortable, SCR-038/tpo-detail

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: T2 (§1.4, E09-D09 §2.1): every gated control keeps its role and full label, the CMP-019 lock leading, the label in color.text.tertiary on the raised fill with the default hairline, aria-disabled (never disabled, never opacity.disabled), the reason visible and linked by aria-describedby

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Entry points only (E19-D04 owns apply / save / overwrite / undo): the Presets menu button in the SCR-038 header, open; items: the built-in 'Session value', the user's presets, 'Save preset…'

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: After a manual change the menu button carries the 'Modified' slot (W-32, E19-D04's word); a preset is available to every profile instance (`11`:1856); storage contract D02-G4

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: T2 (§1.4) 2a inline inside the menu: 'Save preset…' led by the CMP-019 lock (decorative=false, 'Not available'), its full label in color.text.tertiary on the raised fill with the default hairline (E09-D09 §2.1; never color.text.disabled or opacity.disabled); W-15 as the item's second line, mounted with the menu, its own aria-describedby target

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: aria-disabled="true", arrow-reachable (drawn focused); Enter or Space on it changes nothing and re-shows W-15 with one polite announcement (G-T2.3)

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: Under view-as the header switches stay operable and change the view only (not T2)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: CMP-043 760 × 640 at compact (§8.1, PROPOSED): the form column 440 px scrolls, the CMP-228 preview 280 px pinned right; footer Reset · Presets ▾ · Cancel · Save; no horizontal scroll at 1280 × 800 compact (AC 4)

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Initial focus: the first Period radio; Enter in a field never submits; Save applies, closes and announces W-38 once

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: A row size below one tick ('0.5' entered) is replaced by 1 in the field on blur; W-25, naming the entered value, shows inline under it and is announced politely once; never a silent correction (AC 6; `11`:1858–1859)

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: In SCR-038's header stepper the same rule: W-25 becomes the stepper's description, announced politely once on the change

value-4.chars: T2 (§1.4) 2a, CMP-079 RbacGate: Save and the footer Presets menu's 'Save preset…' each led by the CMP-019 lock glyph, the full label in color.text.tertiary, raised fill + default hairline, aria-disabled (never disabled), in the Tab order / arrow-reachable, both described by the one dialog-header notice W-15 (G-T2.5)

value-5.chars: Reset, Cancel and every field stay operable; the preview updates; nothing is saved
